about: ORIGINAL-game values per wfc_fidelity metric id (group.id). 'original' comes either from a capture of the Xbox 360 game (hardware or emulator; leave 'evidence' empty) or from native reverse engineering of the shipped code/data (set 'evidence' to the RE note). Entries with an 'owner' report KNOWN (not FAIL) while a product branch has not adopted the value yet. Never fill from the rebuild or from guesses; null = still needed.
capture_notes: Prefer 60 fps video with a frame counter. Distances: use authored geometry with known UU sizes (street tiles, door frames) or the debug position readout if available. Record build/region/spawn used in 'method'. RE-derived entries should still be confirmed by a capture where practical.

movement.robot_top_speed.evidence: native RE (not a capture): RE-Workspace HANDOFF #1, Optimus_ROBODEF BaseGroundSpeed 1400 via TnPawn.ApplyTransformer
movement.robot_top_speed.method: jog straight along a measured street edge; distance / time over >= 3 s of steady motion

movement.robot_time_to_top_speed.evidence: native RE (not a capture): HANDOFF #1/#2, AccelRate 12000, TnPawn.CalcVelocity per-axis clamp
movement.robot_time_to_top_speed.method: frames from first stick deflection to steady stride speed

movement.robot_stop_time.evidence: native RE (not a capture): TARGETED_PASS #1e, no input on ground -> desired 0 at AccelRate 12000
movement.robot_stop_time.method: frames from stick release to zero displacement (braking model check)

movement.robot_stop_distance.evidence: native RE (not a capture): v^2/2a with 1400 UU/s and 12000 UU/s2
movement.robot_stop_distance.method: slide distance after release from full jog

movement.robot_backpedal_speed.method: hold back while aiming forward; distance / time

movement.robot_jump_apex.evidence: native RE (not a capture): STEPUP_LEDGE #4 trapezoidal physFalling, JumpHeight 500 (SharedAcrobatics)
movement.robot_jump_apex.method: standing jump beside a wall of known height; apex frame

movement.robot_jump_airtime.method: frames from takeoff to landing, standing jump on flat ground

movement.robot_running_jump_distance.method: jog jump on flat ground; takeoff to landing footprint

movement.vehicle_rest_com_height.evidence: native RE (not a capture): M03 P1 L_eq = 250 - 1940.4*(M/4)/10000 UU; algorithm CONFIRMED, mass link M=2500 HIGH. Replaces the stale 1.85 m hover height (185 = SuspensionRadius, the probe radius)
movement.vehicle_rest_com_height.method: side-on capture of the resting truck: COM-plane height vs kerb height

movement.vehicle_cruise_speed.method: vehicle full throttle, no boost, distance / time

movement.vehicle_time_to_cruise.method: frames from throttle to steady cruise

native_vehicle.boost.top_speed_6s.evidence: native RE (not a capture): HANDOFF #6, boost = Driving mode, Truck MaxSpeed 3000
native_vehicle.boost.top_speed_6s.method: hold boost on a long straight; steady speed

movement.vehicle_boost_decay_time.method: frames from boost release to hover cruise speed (0.5 s drift ramp is CONFIRMED; full curve needs a capture)

movement.vehicle_jump_apex.method: vehicle jump height above hover height
